messages:
maria_cs: FYI — Acme reported a big drop in search relevance after last week's rerank rollout. ticket CS-3421. customer says top results are now noisy and latency spiked for same queries.

sanjay_support: digging in now. customer provided query set and sample ids. repro shows avg latency went from ~110ms to ~220ms on their traffic slice. embedding cosine similarities look lower too.

lee_ml: do we know if they switched embedding model or the reranker weights changed? last rerank deploy was Tue (deploy-bot shows 2026-03-12).

maria_cs: Acme says they didn't change anything on their side. they included an example where previous top doc is now ranked 7th.

jon_prod: thanks — this needs prioritization. sounds like a quality regression + perf regression. can we get a quick root-cause hypothesis? is this more likely embedding drift or reranker scoring mismatch?

lee_ml: quick hypothesis: recent quantized embedding model (v2-q4) was rolled and mismatch with old reranker fine-tuned on float embeddings might change score distributions. also batching/kv-cache config changes in runtime could explain latency.

sanjay_support: added logs from customer's session: ``model=redwood-embed-v2-q4, reranker=rerank-small-v1, endpoint=us-west-2, p95=220ms``. attaching a small repro set (10 queries).

jon_prod: OK action items: 1) reproduce on internal infra with their sample 2) run eval harness to compare MRR/Recall between embed v1 vs v2-q4 3) test reranker scores distribution shift 4) temporary mitigation (rollback embed or route Acme to dedicated variant)

lee_ml: I'll run eval harness. need the ground-truth labels — Maria can you confirm Acme shared relevance judgments?

maria_cs: they provided a CSV with relevance labels for 50 queries, sent to S3 link: https://s3.company/acme/repro-50.csv.

lee_ml: perfect. I'll run a runbook: ``python eval/relevancy_eval.py --queries s3://acme/repro-50.csv --embed-model redwood-embed-v1,redwood-embed-v2-q4 --reranker rerank-small-v1`` and post metrics.

eval-bot: queued job #4872: relevancy_eval on repro-50 (embed v1 vs v2-q4). ETA ~45m.

sanjay_support: In parallel, I can put a temporary routing rule so Acme gets routed to embed v1 (non-quantized) for their account. low-risk rollback for immediate customer relief?

jon_prod: do it. set rule for account acme-corp, note in CS ticket. make it reversible.

maria_cs: I'll notify the customer that we're actively triaging and will enable a temporary routing fix.

lee_ml: Eval results: MRR embed-v1=0.68, embed-v2-q4=0.52 on repro set. Reranker score distribution shifted: mean raw score down ~0.14. This explains ranking flips. Latency: model inference slightly faster for v2-q4 single token, but overall p95 increased because batching heuristics changed in runtime after the last deploy.

jon_prod: summary: quality regression due to embedding quantization mismatch + runtime batching change affecting p95. Prioritization: we should treat customer-impacting quality regressions as P1 for product/infra. Proposal: short-term rollback of embed model for Acme + revert batching heuristics; mid-term: calibrate reranker on quantized embeddings or update embed/finetune flow.

lee_ml: proposed acceptance criteria for fix: on Acme repro set, MRR >= 0.65 and p95 latency <= 150ms. need a test harness and automated regression alert.

jon_prod: agree. estimate work: rollback routing + infra tweak (1 engineer, 1 day), reranker calibration + retrain on mixed embeddings (2 engineers, 2-3 sprints).

maria_cs: customer replied: "thanks — we'll accept the routing workaround while you fix it. ETA?"

sanjay_support: rollback routing done, change note CS-3421 updated. applied at 2026-03-13T15:12Z. please monitor.

eval-bot: job #4872 completed. artifacts: https://ci.company/jobs/4872/artifacts/relevancy_report.html

lee_ml: attached quick chart: v1 outperforms v2-q4 on their labels. I'll open an engineering RFC to standardize embedding/reranker compatibility and add a preflight eval for any embed model rollouts.

jon_prod: good. assign tasks: ENG-1098 (rollback automation + routing rules) owner @sanjay_support, due EOD tomorrow; ENG-1099 (reranker calibration + retrain) owner @lee_ml, scope doc due next Wed; PROD-1100 (preflight eval + alerting) owner @jon_prod.

maria_cs: closing loop with customer and setting expectation: we'll follow up when reranker calibration is next in the roadmap. they asked to be notified for canary/release.

jon_prod: final note — let's add a launch criterion: any embedding model that changes numeric distribution must pass cross-model eval vs a representative customer panel before global rollout. I'll draft that into roadmap items. :thumbsup:

maria_cs: thanks team — ticket CS-3421 updated and customer notified.

sanjay_support: monitoring metrics show Acme p95 returned to ~120ms after routing rule. looks resolved for now. :white_check_mark:
